text:
maria: heads up — local sampleapp rerank failing when called from Node SDK, same flow with Python works fine
maria: error seen in logs: TypeError: Cannot read property 'length' of undefined
maria: stack:
```
TypeError: Cannot read property 'length' of undefined
    at Embeddings.toArray (/app/node_modules/redwood-sdk/dist/embeddings.js:45:23)
    at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:94:5)
```
jon: can you paste the raw responses returned by the SDK for node vs python (for the same inputs)?
maria: sure — python response (works):
```
{"id":"e-1","embedding":[0.0012,-0.235,0.003,... /* 1536 floats */],"model":"open-embed-1536"}
```
maria: node response (broken):
```
{"id":"e-1","embeds":["0.0012,-0.235,0.003,..."],"model":"open-embed-1536"}
```
sam: ah ok — looks like Node SDK is returning `embeds` (plural) as CSV string(s) when the call is batched, plus the field name differs from python's `embedding` array. rerank expects numeric array under `embedding` so it crashes
maria: this only happens when I pass an array of inputs (>1). single-input calls return `embedding` fine
lee: sounds like an issue in the batching helper that serializes multiple embeddings for transport. we also had reports of auth retry flow doing weird concat in a different bug — maybe both collided
maria: repro steps I used:
```
// node repro
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'open-embed-1536', input: ['a','b'] })
// observed: result.embeds -> ["0.0012,-0.235,0.003,...","0.0009,0.11,..."]
```
jon: wild. thanks for the repro. sam, can you triage batching helper + auth retry interaction? sounds like two separate parity issues (field name + serialization)
sam: on it. quick temp-fix for anyone blocked: normalize responses in app code: if response.embeds is present, do `embeds.map(s => s.split(',').map(Number))` and then map to `embedding` to keep parity until SDK patch lands
maria: confirmed patch works locally — rerank now accepts the arrays again. i've pushed a small workaround in the sampleapp repo and opened a PR redwood/devex#789
ci-bot: CI: failed job - embeddings-batch-serializer.spec.ts -> expected numeric arrays but saw string CSVs
lee: i'll add a regression test and prepare a hotfix release for the node sdk. also add an integration test that compares node vs python response shapes on the sampleapp CI job
maria: thanks all — saving the workaround in the onboarding guide too. tagging @sam for follow-up on retry path
maria: 🙏
